ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Driver Install by pnputil.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a possible suspicious driver is being installed via pnputil.exe lolbin

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-i.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/install.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-a.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/add\\-driver.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.inf.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\pnputil\\\.exe$"))
